title: Dark house in the woods. Bright, sunny mountain. Swimming underwater (waves).
content: These are reoccurring places I’ve been to my whole life. The large house is a spookier dream. Many times I can fly off the roof. It is usually haunted but I try and deal with it rather than just run away. The sunny mountain dreams are awesome and inspiring. Many times snowboarding or flying. These always leave me happy and refreshed. The waves/swimming dreams are scary at first until I realize I can breathe underwater. Many have started with 100’ tsunamis. They usually end like the final scene of “surfs up”. Happy, sunny, with friends. Just me?
